    Louis Vuitton, Porsche and Singer Just Built the Wildest 911s in Paris

    nova·September 29, 2026
    Share
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:45
    Instaread

    PAUSE Magazine just got a first look at the Louis Vuitton x Porsche x Singer 911 collaboration cars in Paris, and they are exactly as over the top as that sentence suggests.

    Revealed during Paris Fashion Week, the builds pair Singer’s obsessively reimagined 911 with full Louis Vuitton detailing: an LV-monogram-etched windshield, brown leather trunks buckled to the roof rack, “LOUIS VUITTON” spelled across the taillight bar, and cabins trimmed in quilted leather, wood and brass. One car wears burnt orange with blue accents, the other a cream finish with tan leather.
